entries.68d2d962576437c9: In May 2025, the company revised its management philosophy, established the management vision 'Change the "World" with the Power of Content,' and formulated a medium-term management plan covering fiscal 2025 to fiscal 2027. Building on its terrestrial television network and under the slogan 'Nittele, Open the Country! Gear up, go global,' the company is focusing on content production and advancing its transformation into a global content company. The company targets consolidated revenue of ¥700,000 million for fiscal 2033, including overseas revenue of ¥100,000 million.
